reviewer: single Codex AI reviewer; code reading plus mechanical replay; not independent expert physical approval
reviewed_response_scope: Final gradable code for each given row; all four paired initial prompts and stored keys checked; intermediate failed repair code not classified.
classification: Each wrong row has a specific code-level discrepancy; categories name principal observed error, not exclusive psychological causes. Some passed programs contain latent inaccuracies within tolerance.
limits: Selected nine mechanisms from observed V1 low given accuracy; no prevalence inference over all mechanisms/models.
Numerical crosschecks reuse repository alternative algorithms and are not a fresh external physics review.
Diagnostic corrections are post-hoc arithmetic/code checks, not new model observations, new scores, or evidence of learning.
No frozen task, score, threshold, or running evaluation was changed.
